svg.title: The fixture jury, every score, Lantern Notes
svg.desc: The fixture jury, every score: 7 personas in 3 strata (primary 4, secondary 2, bystander 1), 21 columns of lens, dimension and option. Each cell is a score from 1 to 5. primary medians 2 2 2 2 4 2 2 3 3 2 5 1 1 3 3 2 3 2 2 2 2. secondary medians 2 2 2 1 4 1 1 2 2 2 5 1 1 2 2 2 3 2 2 2 2. bystander medians 2 2 2 2 4 2 2 3 3 2 5 1 1 3 3 2 4 2 2 3 3. Blockers per persona: builder-ana 7, builder-mei 2, builder-ravi 2, newcomer-sofia 4, company-george 2, company-hanna 5, investor-claire 4. No row spans strata.

g.text: The fixture jury, every score: Lantern Notes, 7 personas, 21 columns
One row per persona, grouped by stake. The score is printed in every cell; the fill only helps the eye. No row spans strata.
1 is the bottom of the lens's anchors, 5 the top. Blockers: the points a persona marked as stopping it.
Fixture run, report 2026-10-23-v0-1-measured: a fixture we wrote, not a benchmark. Medians are per stratum and per column.
